vulnerability.name: USN-6083-2
vulnerability.description: USN-6083-1 fixed a vulnerability in cups-filters. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that cups-filters incorrectly handled the beh CUPS  backend. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause the  backend to stop responding or to execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: cups-filters could be made to crash or run programs if it received specially crafted network traffic. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
